module: Statistics module that detects "J-turns" (reverse-then-forward U-turn) of the player vehicle and increments the metric "vehicle/jturn" via gameplay_statistic.metricAdd. It is called by gameplay_statistic with the workload function on each watch round.
notes: Condition: speed > 8 m/s; vehicle direction opposite to the velocity (dot product < -0.96) = reverse; then back to forward (> 0.96) with the initial reverse direction opposite to the current velocity (< -0.90) for more than 1 s. Max delay of 4 s after the last reverse, otherwise canceled.
The code comment indicates that simTime "is probably broken": it is accumulated from dtSim.
The onPreRender function (debug) is commented out on export and references an undefined variable vpos: do not enable it.

workload.desc: Analyzes a vehicle on each call (speed, direction) and counts a J-turn when the reverse-then-forward sequence is detected.

vid.desc: Vehicle identifier; a vehicle change cancels the detection.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is reset: cancels the detection if it is the tracked vehicle.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads; does nothing.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the controlled vehicle changes: cancels the detection.
